correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the proof in RESULT.md §§1–4 against Huang–Wen Definitions 3.1–3.5 and 4.1. Identity forces every selected witness for each contradictory antecedent into the anti-logical domain. Its rectangle consists of the rows selecting it and columns it falsifies, so rectangles cover exactly the ones of B=1−T. In SCP1 a zero row needs a selected world with empty falsification set; that world's rectangle can be deleted without affecting rank, and one such world serves every zero row. To realize the bounds, use the factors for the prescribed selections, set all q_j true at the lone normal world, and make every whole formula at each anti-world true except the designated false q_j. Define all other selections by formula complexity: a normal truth selects the normal world, a normal falsity selects nothing in SCP or a fixed anti-world in SCP1. Evaluation of a conditional consults only the previously assigned selection of its strictly smaller antecedent. All normal falsities are true at the fixed anti-world, and the singleton accessibility relations ensure the diamond restrictions apply exactly to normal truths. No fixed anti-world is needed for SCP at rank zero; SCP1 has at least one even for B=0. An embedded identity attains the SCP maximum; a zero row plus min(r−1,s) distinct unit rows attains the SCP1 maximum, including r=1. The supplied check.py is finite corroboration by inspection, not a replay or a proof of the global semantic extension.
